# Synthetic note excerpts (frost overlay evidenced)

## Feature chips over photography

Frosted UI chips sit over a sharp phone photograph. Each chip uses a matte frosted overlay: soft blur of the photo beneath, translucent warm-gray fill, and a quiet gray border. Finish is matte, not glossy glass.

Do not treat soft bokeh circles in the photo as the frosted UI system; those are atmospheric. The transferable material is frosted overlays over imagery.
